Also better to wait

How the day is worked out

What a Choghadiya is

Sunrise to sunset is divided into eight equal parts, and sunset to the next sunrise into eight more. Each part is one Choghadiya - around an hour and a half, but longer in summer and shorter in winter, because it follows the sun rather than the clock. That is why these timings are different in Delhi and in Dubai on the same day.

Why the same hour is Amrit today and Rog tomorrow

Every Choghadiya is ruled by a planet. The first window of the day belongs to the lord of that weekday - Sunday to the Sun, Monday to the Moon - and the rest follow the classical order of the planets. Change the weekday and the whole sequence shifts. Nothing is looked up in a table for the country.

Rahu Kaal, Gulika and Yamaganda

Same eight parts of the daylight, and the weekday decides which one. Rahu Kaal is the second part on a Monday, the third on a Saturday, and so on. Gulika and Yamaganda are two more of the eight, each with their own weekday order. By custom nothing new is begun in them; work already under way carries on.

Abhijit Muhurat

A different division: the daylight split fifteen ways, of which Abhijit is the eighth - the middle one, which is why it always sits on midday. About 48 minutes. It is traditionally not observed on a Wednesday.

Where the numbers come from

Sunrise and sunset are computed from your city's latitude and longitude using the standard NOAA solar-position method, with the usual allowance for refraction and the width of the sun's disc - the same allowance almanacs use. Nothing is fetched from anywhere; it is arithmetic, and it is usually within a few minutes of a printed panchang for your city.

What this is, and what it is not

This is your sun sign

Worked out from your date of birth against fixed calendar dates - the same basis newspapers use, and the basis the reading below is written for.

A rashi is not quite the same thing

In Indian astrology your rashi is a moon sign: which of the twelve the Moon stood in at the moment you were born. That needs your birth time and place, not just the date, and for most people it is a different sign from their sun sign. Parwah never asks for a birth time, so Parwah does not know your rashi and does not claim to. The Hindi names are here because they are the ones families know.

Where the reading comes from

All twelve are fetched once a day from a free, open horoscope source and kept for the whole family, so nobody's phone asks for them again. If a reading does not arrive, that sign is left blank - we would rather show nothing than write one ourselves.

What it is for

A shared thing to read together, the way a family reads the paper. It is not advice, and nothing else in Parwah - medicines, documents, reminders - is decided by it.

    Safety

    Checking…

    Tell the family if I miss a medicineOff

    Only you choose this. With it on, the family gets one gentle note when a medicine has no tick two hours after its time.

    Privacy promise

    Your family is private. No ads, no data selling, no public feed. What is kept here is seen only by the people in your family - papers and private entries only by whoever their owner chooses - and anything set for someone starts only when they accept it.

    💛 Parwah Care

    Nothing is charged. Parwah does not handle money - when Care opens, payment will go through a licensed partner. Reserving only tells us your family wants it.

    🪙 Family coins

    - in the family pot

    One pot for the whole family. Keeping the family's records current earns coins, and Ekta spends them: each question to Ekta uses 2 coins. Reading back your records, the scam check and anything urgent are free. Nothing is charged. Coins are earned inside the family, not bought.

    Ekta answers using whichever AI key is set. Add one and she wakes up; add several and she falls back automatically if one fails. Keys are stored server-side and never shown again.

    Anthropic: console.anthropic.com → API keys · Gemini: aistudio.google.com/apikey · OpenAI: platform.openai.com/api-keys. If Anthropic replies "workspace id is required", add the workspace ID here too.

      • Never share an OTP or your UPI PIN. Nobody real needs them.
      • Police never arrest anyone on a video call.
      • Banks never ask for KYC on a phone call.

      📱 Help with my phone

      Send the family a picture of the screen and a few words. Someone will say "I'm on it".

      How to

      Start a video call

      Video call kaise karein

      1. On Today, tap More, then Family call.
      2. Tap Start the call. Everyone in the family gets a message.
      3. If the phone asks, tap Allow for the camera and the microphone.
      4. To end the call, tap the red phone button.
      Share a photo on WhatsApp

      WhatsApp par photo bhejein

      1. Open WhatsApp and tap the person's chat.
      2. Tap the paperclip 📎 next to where you type. On an iPhone, tap +.
      3. Tap Gallery (Photos on an iPhone) and pick the photo.
      4. Tap the green arrow to send.
      PhonePe or Google Pay looks different: where is Pay?

      App ka look badla hai, paise wahi hain

      1. Apps change their look sometimes. Your money stays the same.
      2. Look for Scan & Pay, or a small QR code picture, near the top or the bottom middle.
      3. To pay a person, tap To Contact (or Pay contacts) and pick the name.
      4. Your UPI PIN is only for sending money. You never need it to receive money.
      5. Not sure? Do not pay. Send us a picture of the screen first.
      Spot a fake KYC message

      Nakli KYC message pehchanein

      1. Banks do not ask for KYC on a call, an SMS or a WhatsApp link.
      2. "Your account will be blocked today" is said to rush you.
      3. Do not tap the link. Do not share an OTP or your PIN.
      4. Call the number on the back of your bank card, or call us.
      5. To report it, call 1930 or visit cybercrime.gov.in.
      Life certificate with the face app

      Jeevan Pramaan, ghar baithe

      1. From the Play Store, install the official Jeevan Pramaan app and the AadhaarFaceRD app.
      2. Keep ready your PPO number (on the pension book) and the phone linked to Aadhaar.
      3. Sit in good light and look at the phone. Take off your glasses if it asks.
      4. Follow the steps. Write down the acknowledgement number at the end.
      5. Dates and steps are as announced each year. Check on jeevanpramaan.gov.in.
      Make the text bigger on Android

      Android par akshar bade karein

      1. Open Settings (the gear ⚙️).
      2. Tap Display, then Font size. On some phones it is Display size and text.
      3. Slide to the right. The text gets bigger everywhere.
      Make the text bigger on an iPhone

      iPhone par akshar bade karein

      1. Open Settings.
      2. Tap Display & Brightness, then Text Size.
      3. Drag the slider to the right.
      4. Bigger still: Settings, Accessibility, Display & Text Size, Larger Text.

      A yearly task with a checklist. At 80 and over it can be given from 1 October, otherwise from 1 to 30 November. Dates are as announced each year: confirm on jeevanpramaan.gov.in.

      Parwah never takes a face scan or an Aadhaar number. It keeps the checklist and the acknowledgement number.

          Your account is deleted after 7 days. Until then you can sign in and tap "Keep my account". Your own private things are deleted. What you shared with a family stays, with no name on it, unless you tick the box.

          What your family wrote about you

          Before you had Parwah, your family wrote these down. For each one choose: keep it, hide it from others, or delete it.
